title: Managing Chronic Conditions
description: Plain-text reference with preparation and emergency management for diabetes, heart disease and hypertension, asthma and COPD, epilepsy, kidney disease, and mental health conditions. Covers medication rationing, when to seek care, and a medical documentation template.
shortDescription: Diabetes, heart disease, asthma, epilepsy, and kidney care without a clinic
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
